key.name: macos-style
key.description: Replace the normal Dash-to-Dock presentation with a high-resolution, compositor-animated macOS-style dock while keeping Dash-to-Dock as the application, window, menu, autohide and drag-and-drop backend.

key.name: macos-magnification
key.description: Maximum extra scale of an icon under the pointer. 0.85 gives a peak scale of 1.85x.

key.name: macos-magnification-radius
key.description: Distance in stage pixels over which the continuous raised-cosine fish-eye wave influences icons.

key.name: macos-spring-response
key.description: Natural angular response of the frame-clock spring. Higher values follow the pointer more quickly.

key.name: macos-spring-damping
key.description: Damping ratio of the icon motion spring. 1.0 is critically damped and avoids overshoot.

key.name: macos-icon-quality
key.description: Multiplier used when pre-creating maximum-resolution icon textures. Textures are created once and then compositor-scaled instead of being resized every frame.

key.name: macos-glass-blur
key.summary: Enable frosted glass blur when supported
key.description: Use true rounded dynamic background blur when a compatible gnome-rounded-blur provider is available. Otherwise use the seamless rounded translucent material without Gaussian blur so no rectangular blur artifact is shown.

key.name: macos-glass-radius
key.description: Blur radius used by the optional rounded dynamic blur provider.

key.name: macos-glass-opacity
key.description: Panel opacity used when adaptive light and dark material is disabled.

key.name: macos-corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the floating dock material.

key.name: macos-adaptive-dark
key.summary: Adapt material to system light and dark mode
key.description: Use a light frosted material in light mode and translucent charcoal in dark mode.

key.name: macos-light-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the light material when adaptive appearance is enabled.

key.name: macos-dark-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the charcoal material when adaptive appearance is enabled.

key.name: macos-dynamic-border
key.description: Use a thin light border on dark material and a thin dark border on light material.

key.name: macos-border-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the one-pixel contrast-adaptive dock border.

key.name: macos-reflection
key.description: Show a subtle mirrored clone of application icons on the dock surface when the dock is on the bottom edge.

key.name: macos-reflection-opacity
key.description: Maximum opacity of the mirrored icon reflection.

key.name: macos-reflection-height
key.description: Vertical compression factor of the mirrored icon reflection.

key.name: macos-divider
key.description: Draw a separator before mounted locations, files, folders and Trash instead of using the favorites-versus-running-app divider.

key.name: macos-divider-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the structural divider line.
